top.summary: The global isobutanol market is projected to grow from USD 0.74 billion in 2025 to USD 1.89 billion by 2035, representing a 38% CAGR. Growth is driven by increasing demand for sustainable biofuel components, bio-based chemicals, and applications in coatings, solvents, and pharmaceuticals. Bio-based isobutanol is the fastest-growing segment, with Asia Pacific leading regional growth due to industrialization and green chemistry initiatives.

top.title: Blowing Agent Market Size to Reach USD 2.94 Billion by 2035 on Rising Demand for Low-GWP Insulation Solutions | SNS Insider
top.summary: The global blowing agent market is projected to grow from USD 1.79 billion in 2025 to USD 2.94 billion by 2035, driven by increasing demand for eco-friendly foam insulation, regulatory requirements to ban high-GWP compounds, and energy-efficient building construction. Chemical blowing agents dominate with 51.8% market share, while HFO technology is the fastest-growing segment. North America leads with 32.5% market share, with the U.S. market expected to reach USD 0.56 billion by 2035, while Europe is projected to reach USD 0.66 billion.

top.title: VIA DEADLINE: ROSEN, A LONGSTANDING AND TRUSTED FIRM, Encourages Via Transportation, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – VIA
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is notifying investors about securities class action lawsuits, with an August 10, 2026 deadline to serve as lead plaintiff. The main case involves Via Transportation, Inc., where the firm alleges the IPO offering documents were false and misleading regarding the company's declining revenue growth and inability to expand in Germany, resulting in a ~70% stock price decline.

top.title: VRRM IMPORTANT DEADLINE: ROSEN, A LEADING AND RANKED FIRM, Encourages Verra Mobility Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important August 4 Deadline in Securities Class Action – VRRM
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Verra Mobility Corporation, Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc., and Wix.com Ltd. The primary case detailed involves Verra Mobility, where investors who purchased stock between February 24, 2026 and May 26, 2026 may be entitled to compensation. The lawsuit alleges that Verra provided false and misleading statements regarding its relationship with Avis Budget Group and contract extension prospects while concealing material adverse facts. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 4, 2026.

top.title: ROBLOX DEADLINE: ROSEN, A LEADING AND LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages Roblox Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important August 7 Deadline in Securities Class Action – RBLX
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Roblox Corporation, Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc., and Wix.com Ltd. The Roblox lawsuit alleges the company made false statements about organic growth potential while concealing material adverse facts regarding enrollment slowdowns and reduced app store ratings. Investors who purchased shares during specified periods are encouraged to join the class action before the August 7, 2026 deadline.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts modestly richer than calls (-1.2 vol pts vs peers) — mild downside hedge
reasons.zh: 看跌略贵于看涨（-1.2 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和下行对冲

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: long-gamma — dealer hedging dampens the move
reasons.zh: 多头 Gamma — 做市商对冲抑制波动

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts modestly richer than calls (-1.4 vol pts vs peers) — mild downside hedge
reasons.zh: 看跌略贵于看涨（-1.4 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和下行对冲

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Erasca, Inc. faces a securities class action lawsuit alleging that the company and its executives made false statements about its lead drug candidate ERAS-0015. The lawsuit claims Erasca's preclinical data involved improper comparisons and failed to disclose patent infringement risks from Revolution Medicines. Following disclosure of a patent assertion letter and adverse clinical trial data on April 27, 2026, Erasca's stock fell approximately 59% over two trading days. Investors with substantial losses can seek lead plaintiff status by August 10, 2026.

top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Erasca, Inc. and its executives for allegedly making false and misleading statements about its lead oncology drug candidate ERAS-0015. The company is accused of improperly comparing its drug to a competitor's candidate and failing to disclose patent and trade secret disputes. Investors who purchased Erasca stock between January 14, 2025 and April 26, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is August 10, 2026.

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +11.7 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +11.7 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

reasons.en: call-over-put richness building vs the prior session — demand rotating up
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期上升 — 需求转向上行

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

ZoomInfo's stock fell to $4.06 per share on May 12, 2026, following the disclosure of deteriorated growth outlook and reduced full-year 2026 guidance. Investors who purchased securities during the class period may be eligible to participate, with an August 24, 2026 deadline to seek lead plaintiff appointment.

top.summary: Pomerantz LLP has filed a class action lawsuit against Hertz Global Holdings for alleged securities fraud. The lawsuit stems from Hertz's June 24, 2026 announcement of a $300 million capital raise and 37 million share offering, coupled with disclosure of unexpected losses in the used car market that would significantly reduce second-quarter earnings. The stock fell 40.71% on the news. Investors have until September 22, 2026 to join the class action.

top.title: HTZ Shareholder Alert: Investors With Losses May Seek to Lead the Class Action in Hertz Global Holdings Securities Lawsuit - Contact SueWallSt
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Hertz Global Holdings on behalf of shareholders who purchased securities between May 7, 2026 and June 23, 2026. The complaint alleges that CEO Wayne Gilbert West and CFO Scott M. Haralson made materially false or misleading statements about the company's liquidity and fleet-management strategy shortly before announcing a dilutive financing. HTZ shares declined over 40% to $3.00 on June 24, 2026, following the announcement of exchangeable notes and a share-lending transaction involving 37 million shares.

The project aims to establish independent manufacturing hubs in West Africa and Australia to reduce reliance on Chinese robotics production.

top.title: Portnoy Law Firm Announces Class Action on Behalf of Lucid Group, Inc. Investors
top.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has announced a class action lawsuit on behalf of Lucid Group investors who purchased securities between February 25, 2026 and April 13, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Lucid made false and misleading statements regarding a supplier quality issue that significantly disrupted Lucid Gravity deliveries, overstated manufacturing capabilities, and failed to disclose the material negative impact on business and financial results.

top.title: Kaplan Fox Alerts Lucid Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: LCID) Investors Who Suffered Losses to a Securities Class Action – Deadline is July 28, 2026
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Lucid Group on behalf of investors who purchased shares between February 25, 2026 and April 13, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Lucid made false and misleading statements regarding its manufacturing capabilities and financial performance. The company disclosed a supplier quality issue that disrupted Gravity deliveries for 29 days, resulting in significant stock price declines of 11.35% and 4.76% following separate announcements in early April 2026. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is July 28, 2026.

top.title: DEADLINE ALERT for AVAV, CALX, ZTS, and LCID: The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz Reminds Investors of Class Actions on Behalf of Shareholders
top.summary: Class action lawsuits have been filed against AeroVironment, Calix, Zoetis, and Lucid Group, alleging that company executives made materially false statements and failed to disclose material adverse facts about their businesses. The lawsuits cover various issues including understated competition, supply chain problems, declining product adoption, and manufacturing disruptions. Lead plaintiff deadlines range from July 27-28, 2026.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +2.1 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +2.1 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

reasons.en: call-over-put richness building vs the prior session — demand rotating up
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期上升 — 需求转向上行

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Implicity announced FDA 510(k) clearance for its next-generation ILR ECG Analyzer, a cloud-based AI software that reduces false-positive alerts from implantable cardiac monitors by up to 76% while maintaining high sensitivity. The manufacturer-agnostic algorithm works with devices from Abbott, Biotronik, Boston Scientific, and Medtronic, addressing a significant clinical workflow burden in remote cardiac monitoring.

top.title: Ultrasonic Aspirator Market Size Projected to Reach USD 376.32 Million by 2035 | SNS Insider
top.summary: The global ultrasonic aspirator market is valued at USD 194.03 million in 2025 and is projected to reach USD 376.32 million by 2035, growing at a CAGR of 6.87%. The U.S. market is expected to grow from USD 67.49 million to USD 118.90 million by 2035, driven by increasing adoption of advanced surgical technologies, rising neurosurgery procedures, and growing demand for minimally invasive surgeries. North America leads the market with 39.80% share, while Asia-Pacific registers the fastest growth at 8.83% CAGR.

top.title: MEXC Users Put Nearly a Third of First-Month RealStocks Volume Into SpaceX
top.summary: MEXC's RealStocks platform, which launched June 1st offering access to 7,000+ US stocks and ETFs, reported strong first-month trading insights. SpaceX dominated with 29.70% of trading volume, while seven AI-related assets collectively captured 23.67% of volume. The platform attracted over 120,000 users in its first month, with more than 40% of volume distributed outside the top 10 holdings, indicating portfolio-building behavior rather than speculative trading.

top.title: ROSEN, GLOBAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Microvast Holdings, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - MVST
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against Microvast Holdings, Inc. and other companies on behalf of investors who purchased securities during specified periods. The lawsuit alleges that Microvast made materially false and misleading statements regarding margin targets, inventory management, and the completion of facility expansions. Investors who purchased securities during the class period may be eligible for compensation.

top.title: Portnoy Law Firm Announces Class Action on Behalf of Microvast Holdings, Inc. Investors
top.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Microvast Holdings on behalf of investors who purchased securities between April 1, 2025 and March 16, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Microvast misrepresented its manufacturing expansion capabilities and margin improvement targets. The company's stock fell 34.2% on March 17, 2026, after disclosing a sharp decline in gross margins to 1% and a 15% year-over-year revenue decrease, attributed to inventory issues and customer delays.

top.title: Pomerantz Law Firm Announces the Filing of a Class Action Against Nano-X Imaging Ltd.and Certain Officers – NNOX
top.summary: Pomerantz LLP filed a class action lawsuit against Nano-X Imaging Ltd. and certain officers for alleged securities fraud. The lawsuit claims defendants made false statements about operational efficiency and demand, while the company was actually experiencing poor production alignment, increased expenses, and cash burn. The truth emerged on April 20, 2026, when Nano-X reported a $17.5 million impairment charge related to restructuring its Korean manufacturing facility and announced its CFO's departure, causing the stock to fall 24.39%.

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+6.7% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +6.7%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +6.3 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +6.3 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

reasons.en: call-over-put richness building vs the prior session — demand rotating up
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期上升 — 需求转向上行

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

top.summary: Silvaco and NVIDIA announced a collaboration to advance digital twins for semiconductor design and manufacturing. The partnership combines Silvaco's physics-based simulation expertise with NVIDIA's accelerated computing, AI, and libraries to enable faster simulation cycles, improved accuracy, and scaled engineering workflows. A proof point demonstrated a 3D FDTD photonic simulation with 3.2 billion mesh nodes completed on 32 NVIDIA GPUs in under four hours.

North America leads the market with 39.80% share, while Asia-Pacific registers the fastest growth at 8.83% CAGR.

It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Trevi Therapeutics announced that senior management will participate in two biotech conferences in August 2026, including Oppenheimer's Biotech in the Berkshires on August 4 and Stifel's 2026 Biotech Summer Summit on August 10-12. The company is developing Haduvio (oral nalbuphine ER) for treating chronic cough in patients with IPF, non-IPF ILD, and RCC, with clinical trials showing statistically significant reductions in cough frequency.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -10.8 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -10.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Faites-vous plaisir: PFK Canada lance Kwench, une nouvelle marque de boissons
top.summary: PFK Canada launches Kwench, a new beverage brand featuring four categories of specialty drinks (Krunch Shakes, Sparkling Lemonades, Pearl Tea Refreshments, and Iced Lattes). The brand will be available in over 170 locations by end of summer, expanding to 600 by 2027, with a $30 million investment from PFK and franchisees. This marks Kwench's North American debut and represents PFK's expansion beyond its core chicken business.

top.title: Come Get It: KFC Canada Launches New Beverage Brand to Kwench Nationwide Thirst
top.summary: KFC Canada has launched Kwench, a new specialty beverage brand featuring made-to-order drinks across four categories: Krunch Shakes, Sparkling Lemonades, Boba Refreshers, and Iced Lattes. Starting at $3.50, the brand will expand from 170 locations by summer 2026 to 600 locations in 2027, backed by a $30 million investment. This marks KFC Canada's first expansion outside its core chicken category and the North American debut of the globally successful Kwench brand.

top.title: ZILLOW DEADLINE: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Zillow Group, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm - Z, ZG
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm announces a securities class action lawsuit against Zillow Group, Inc. for allegedly making materially false and misleading statements regarding its agreement with Redfin Corporation. The lawsuit claims Zillow mischaracterized the transaction as a partnership rather than an acquisition, failed to disclose heightened antitrust regulatory risks, and downplayed legal exposure following an antitrust lawsuit filing. Investors who purchased Zillow stock between February 11, 2025 and May 7, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 10, 2026.
